description: This file contains shell functions and script logic for managing the upgrade process of an OpenWRT-based device, including handling NAND and NOR flash upgrades and setting boot parameters.

methods.name: glinet_using_boot_dev_switch
methods.description: Checks if the boot device switch is on by querying environment variables.

methods.name: glinet_set_next_boot_nand
methods.description: Sets environment variables to configure next boot for NAND.

methods.name: glinet_set_next_boot_nor
methods.description: Sets environment variables to configure next boot for NOR.

methods.name: glinet_nand_nor_do_upgrade
methods.description: Coordinates the upgrade process for NAND or NOR based on the function calls.

methods.name: nand_nor_do_upgrade
methods.description: Handles the actual upgrade process, determining whether to upgrade NOR or NAND based on the magic number in the upgrade file.
